verdict.rationale: Mailchimp offers transactional sending through Mailchimp Transactional (formerly Mandrill), described as event-driven messages via API or SMTP. Supporting docs cover message-event webhooks (send, bounce, delivered, open, click), dedicated IPs and allowlist management. It exists alongside the separate Marketing API for campaigns, but a community report says Mandrill still isn't integrated with Mailchimp years after the two were combined, so 'same platform' means two distinct products and APIs rather than one unified API. missing for 10: a unified API for transactional and marketing sends, explicit docs for a transactional email-send endpoint and receipt/magic-link use cases, independent hands-on corroboration of reliable transactional delivery.
